description: This file defines the ContributionTrackingService class responsible for tracking AI contributions, managing tokens, computing line hashes, generating diffs, and sending contribution data to an external attributions worker. It includes methods for token management, diff parsing, line hashing, and contribution reporting, as well as a helper function for fire-and-forget contribution tracking.

classes.name: ContributionTrackingService
classes.description: A singleton service class for managing contribution tracking, token handling, diff parsing, and communication with the attributions worker.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ContributionTrackingService.

methods.name: clearCachedToken
methods.description: Clears the cached token and fetch promise, useful for testing or logout.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the cached token is valid based on organization ID and expiry time.

methods.name: fetchToken
methods.description: Fetches a new short-lived token from the backend for a given organization.

methods.name: getValidToken
methods.description: Returns a valid token, fetching a new one if necessary, with caching and concurrency handling.

methods.name: computeLineHash
methods.description: Computes a SHA-1 hash of a line's content after normalizing whitespace and line endings.

methods.name: extractLineNumbers
methods.description: Extracts line numbers of added and removed lines from a unified diff string.

methods.name: extractLineChanges
methods.description: Combines line number extraction and hashing to produce line change objects for added and removed lines.

methods.name: generateFormattedDiff
methods.description: Creates a unified diff between original and formatted content, normalizing line endings.

methods.name: trackContribution
methods.description: Main method to track a file contribution, including diff generation, line change extraction, token management, and sending data.

methods.name: sendToAttributionsWorker
methods.description: Sends contribution payload to the external attributions worker API.
